text:
I'm sorry about the mix-up. Once an order has shipped, the shipping address can't be changed, and couriers don't accept redirection requests from Leafy, so I can't redirect this parcel to your dad's place.

Express also isn't an option for his address. Island addresses are Zone 3, where Express isn't available. Standard takes 5-8 business days, and live plants only ship Monday to Wednesday. A new order would be possible, but I can't say what happens to the one already shipped (for example whether it could be returned), because the policy doesn't cover that. I can escalate it to a Support Lead to look at options. If you'd like that, send me the order number (LF- plus six digits).
